summary: Core media plumbing was tidied: a race between blob promise handling in MediaRecorder and MediaEncoder was fixed (preventing lost or mis-delivered recording blobs), picture-region logic for image/video conversion was corrected, and NV12 stride/validation was tightened to avoid corrupt frames. A stray telemetry probe was removed and a few small code-cleanups reduce shadowing and unused code — overall making recording, encoding, and image conversion more reliable for users and developers.
